answer: Post a standing informant bounty: anyone who cryptographically proves two identities share one controller — one funding wallet, one device key signing for both — collects from a confiscation pool drawn from the farm's frozen rewards. A sybil operator's puppets cannot avoid shared secrets: one command channel, one funding path. Honest agents have no co-controlled twin, so the rule costs them nothing. The ferrous backbone of the farm — its shared control — is exactly what the bounty buys, and scaling from a dune of puppets into a velvet operation only multiplies the informants.
